description: Land Acquisition - Compensations for the acquisitions of the land in Rambukkana  D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices published under the Land Acquisition Act. It deals specifically with the acquisition of specific land parcels, compensation deposits for land owners, and detailed descriptions of land properties including names, plan numbers, lot numbers, extents, and boundary locations. This falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land acquisition and property matters.
